conviction_note: Zero on two independent grounds: the issuer's MFN calendar and Inderes both put the Q3 report on 2026-11-17 07:30, not 2026-11-10, so no release lands in this window; and the stock is pinned at the SEK 62 unconditional mandatory cash offer that Telenor Sverige launched on 2026-11-06 after buying 57.5% of the shares and 87.9% of the votes, so even the real report would be noise.

already_public.what: Telenor agreed to buy the founders' stake (50.8% of capital, 86% of votes, SEK 60) and Öresund's 6.7% (SEK 62), and said it would follow with a mandatory offer at SEK 62

H1 2026 report: revenue 1158.4 MSEK (+7%), EBIT 150.1 MSEK (+7%), FY guide of 2.4 bn SEK revenue and an EBIT margin above 12% reiterated. The CEO wrote that from a market point of view the report mattered less than usual
The Norwegian unit is to be transferred to K.N. Telecom for 35 MSEK, and the mandatory offer price stays at SEK 62
The Swedish Competition Authority approved the deal and FDI clearance came from ISP on 2026-10-20, so all regulatory conditions were met. The stock went from 59.8 to 61.7 the next session

Telenor Sverige completed the purchase of 57.5% of the shares and 87.9% of the votes and made an unconditional mandatory cash offer of SEK 62 per share. The acceptance period ends 7 December, and the independent committee's statement is due no later than two weeks before that

baseline_tension: No tension. The +3.68% run-up in all three windows is the jump from the merger-arbitrage spread (59.8) to the offer price (62.0) on approval (2026-11-02) and completion (2026-11-06). It is fully explained and fully priced.
language_note: The Swedish sources carried nothing the English ones did not on the facts. Bahnhof's own deal release is Swedish and Telenor's is bilingual, with the same content.

Only the Swedish wire (EFN / Nyhetsbyrån Direkt, 2026-11-06) carried the acceptance-period end of 7 December and the committee's deadline, quoted as 'En oberoende kommitté i styrelsen för Bahnhof kommer att lämna sin uppfattning om budet senast två veckor före utgången av acceptfristen den 7 december' (an independent board committee will give its view on the offer no later than two weeks before the acceptance period ends on 7 December). Telenor's English stock exchange note referred readers to the offer website instead.
The Q3 date (2026-11-17) came from MFN's issuer calendar, a Nordic aggregator, not from a Swedish-language document as such.
lessons_applied: nothing changed. The file's rule 'in a live bid, results are noise; the offer is the finding' agrees with the draft, and here the offer is unconditional and controlled by a holder of 87.9% of the votes, so the offer is no finding inside this window either.
